raw.query: WITH hf AS (SELECT image_px,n_images,mean_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE engine='eager' AND source_path LIKE '%fn_multires%' AND is_valid), aic AS (SELECT image_px,n_images,mean_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE engine='aic' AND source_path LIKE '%aic_multires%' AND is_valid) SELECT hf.image_px, hf.n_images, (hf.mean_ms/aic.mean_ms)::numeric(10,4) AS ratio FROM hf JOIN aic USING (image_px,n_images) ORDER BY 1,2
raw.observed: eager/AIC ratio spans 1.1876–1.7877 over 30 (px,N) pairs; per-px: 224px 1.59–1.79 (avg 1.67, 9/10 above band), 448px 1.32–1.61 (avg 1.47), 672px 1.19–1.59 (avg 1.45); 18/30 pairs outside [1.4,1.6]
raw.claimed: HuggingFace forward is 1.4–1.6× slower over the same range
raw.evidence: collector_encoder_fn eager(fn_multires)/aic(aic_multires) join gives 1.19–1.79, not 1.4–1.6; band breaks systematically at 224px (≥1.59) and at low N for 448/672px (<1.4)
